purpose: Define the fail-closed evidence contract required after implementation before DataNexus may claim a capability, release, or the remaining platform is certified or production-verified.

requirements: protected base branch
exact-head required checks
immutable external CI action references
no merge when a protected context is failing, cancelled, skipped, stale or pending
explicit least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN permissions
dangerous trigger review including pull_request_target
untrusted pull-request code cannot receive privileged secrets or write authority
workflow dependency references are immutable
lockfile-exact dependency resolution
vulnerability policy gate
static security analysis
no unresolved release-blocking findings
authorized positive path
unauthorized negative path
cross-project or cross-scope negative path
direct-bypass attempt
object identifiers are revalidated rather than trusted from the client
authorization is evaluated before privileged mutation or lock acquisition where practical
RLS and grants match intended client and service authority
SECURITY DEFINER functions are explicitly justified and least-executable
SECURITY DEFINER search paths are fixed and object references are safe
member and non-member runtime tests exist for exposed privileged helpers
governance truth cannot be mutated through an unsupported direct path
released migrations are immutable
forward-only repairs represent management-applied production changes in repository history
clean reconstruction reaches the current schema contract
repository and production migration aliases are explicit where immutable history differs
post-migration live invariants are verified
build provenance binds source commit to builder identity
release artifact or deployment output has an immutable digest or equivalent verifiable identity
provenance is generated by the build or deployment system rather than hand-authored
the production deployment can be traced back to the certified source commit
production deployment identifier is recorded
deployment source commit equals the certified commit
production alias or domain resolves to the intended deployment
required runtime configuration names and external dependency selection are verified without storing secret values
live authenticated business journey succeeds
live unauthorized or adversarial journey fails closed
live degraded behavior preserves truth and evidence integrity
runtime evidence is from the production boundary, not a preview or synthetic substitute
changed surfaces have recovery, rollback, compensation or explicit escalation semantics
recovery evidence is appropriate to database, application, storage, identity and external dependency impact
irreversible changes cannot claim reversibility
recovery drills or restoration evidence are current enough for the certified release
material workflow SLIs are emitted
failure and retry evidence is observable
audit and trace evidence can be correlated to the governed workflow
relevant workflow SLOs are measured rather than inferred from HTTP availability alone
model output cannot authorize itself or become governance truth
retrieval remains permission-scoped and evidence-addressable
provider, model, policy and evaluation versions are attributable
abstention and provider failure paths are explicit
only verified outcomes may influence governed learning
persona-facing capabilities preserve one canonical governance truth
authorization is independent of presentation
all affected canonical personas can complete their intended task through an authenticated live journey
accessibility and keyboard-critical paths are validated for affected interactive surfaces
every accepted exception has an owner
rationale and compensating controls are recorded
review due date or expiry is recorded
closure condition is explicit
release-blocking R3 authorization, evidence-integrity or governance-truth gaps are not waived

completionRule.IMPLEMENTED: The capability exists and its deterministic implementation contracts pass; this is not a certification claim.
completionRule.CERTIFIED: All evidence classes required for CERTIFIED are fresh PASS or justified NOT_APPLICABLE; no required class is FAIL, NOT_MEASURED or stale.
completionRule.PRODUCTION_VERIFIED: CERTIFIED is satisfied and every production-only evidence class is fresh PASS or justified NOT_APPLICABLE, with exact source/build/deployment/database/runtime binding and no unresolved release-blocking residual risk.
